events.headline: Anthropic launches Claude and Claude Instant via API

source.title: Introducing Claude

corroboration.publisher: Anthropic (price sheet PDF linked from the post)

capabilities: Claude Instant: $1.63 prompt / $5.51 completion per million tokens, 9,000-token context ('1/6th the cost' of Claude)
Dedicated capacity pricing by contacting sales; early-access waitlist plus API via developer console

events.notes: The launch post itself prints no prices; figures come from the linked PDF (file name 'apr-pricing-tokens', stamped 2023-05-10) so they may reflect the April/May 2023 sheet rather than launch-day prices. Pre-launch closed alpha Dec 2022 is in scout-2021-2022. Claude 1/Instant retired Nov 6 2024.

events.headline: Claude's context window expands from 9K to 100K tokens
events.summary: On May 11, 2023 Anthropic expanded Claude's API context window from 9K to 100K tokens (about 75,000 words), showing Claude Instant finding a modified line in The Great Gatsby's 72K tokens in 22 seconds.

source.title: 100K Context Windows

events.notes: No price stated in the post; the Nov 2023 price sheet lists Instant and Claude 2.0 with 100,000-token context at $1.63/$5.51 and $8/$24.

events.headline: Claude 2 launches with 100K context at Claude 1.3 pricing
events.summary: Claude 2 launched July 11, 2023 with a 100K-token context, a public claude.ai beta in the US and UK and API access 'at the same price as Claude 1.3', scoring 76.5% on the bar exam and 71.2% on HumanEval.

source.title: Claude 2

capabilities: 2x better at harmless responses than Claude 1.3 (internal red-team); customers Jasper, Sourcegraph

events.notes: Launch price = Claude 1.3's per the post ('same price'); $11.02/$32.68 is from the Apr/May 2023 sheet (VERIFY launch-day sheet). Cut to $8/$24 announced with Claude 2.1 on 2023-11-21. Retired Jul 21 2025.

events.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Pro at $20/month in the US and UK
events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Pro on September 7, 2023 at $20 per month (GBP 18 in the UK), offering 5x the free tier's usage, priority access in busy periods and early access to new features.

source.title: Introducing Claude Pro

corroboration.publisher: Anthropic (Help Center: Pro still $20 monthly, annual discounted)

events.headline: Claude 2.1 launches with 200K context; price sheet $8/$24

source.title: Introducing Claude 2.1

capabilities: 2x decrease in false statements vs Claude 2.0; 30% fewer incorrect answers; 3-4x lower rate of wrongly concluding a document supports a claim
200K context reserved for Pro users; tool use (beta) and system prompts

Sheet text extracted locally from the PDF; scout-2023 independently recorded the same sheet. Implied Claude 2.x cut -27% vs the Apr/May 2023 sheet. Retired Jul 21 2025.

events.summary: Anthropic launched the Claude 3 family on March 4, 2024 with Opus at $15/$75, Sonnet at $3/$15 and Haiku at $0.25/$1.25 per MTok, 200K context (1M for select customers), Sonnet powering free claude.ai, Opus for Pro, and ASL-2 classification.

events.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Team at $30/user (5-seat minimum) and iOS app

events.headline: Anthropic launches prompt caching: reads at 10% of input price
events.summary: Anthropic introduced prompt caching on the API (public beta) in August 2024 with cache writes at +25% and cache reads at 10% of base input price - e.g. 3.5 Sonnet $3 -> $3.75 write/$0.30 read - claiming up to 90% lower cost and 85% lower latency for long prompts.

source.title: Prompt caching with Claude

capabilities: Cache write 1.25x base input; cache read 0.1x (Sonnet $0.30, Opus $1.50, Haiku $0.03 per MTok at launch)
Examples: 100K-token chat 79% lower latency/90% lower cost; 10-turn conversation 53% cheaper
GA on Anthropic API and preview on Bedrock/Vertex on 2024-12-17; 1-hour cache Aug 13 2025 (no beta header); automatic caching Feb 19 2026; cache reads on Opus 5.5 now 0.05x and on Fable 5.1 0.025x

events.notes: Date: the claude.com copy is labelled 'August 14, 2025' but carries a Dec 17 2024 update line, so the launch is Aug 2024; other Anthropic/T2 confirmation of Aug 14 2024 not opened (day precision VERIFY). Multipliers unchanged for most models through Sep 2026 (docs: 1.25x/2x write, 0.1x read).

events.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Enterprise with 500K context and GitHub integration
events.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Enterprise on September 4, 2024 with a 500K-token context window, native GitHub integration, SSO/SCIM/audit logs and no training on customer data, pricing undisclosed but above Team's $30 per seat, with GitLab, Midjourney, IG Group and Menlo Ventures as early customers.

source.title: Anthropic launches Claude Enterprise plan to compete with OpenAI

events.headline: Anthropic launches Message Batches API at 50% off
events.summary: Anthropic launched the Message Batches API on October 8, 2024 offering 50% off standard prices with results within 24 hours - e.g. 3.5 Sonnet $1.50/$7.50, Opus $7.50/$37.50, Haiku $0.125/$0.625 - and moved it to general availability on December 17, 2024.

source.title: Introducing the Message Batches API

events.headline: Claude 3.5 Haiku released at $1/$5, four times Claude 3 Haiku
events.summary: Claude 3.5 Haiku reached the API on November 4, 2024 at $1/$5 per MTok - four times Claude 3 Haiku's $0.25/$1.25 - which Anthropic justified because it 'surpassed Claude 3 Opus on many benchmarks at a fraction of the cost', reversing earlier guidance that price would be unchanged.

events.summary: After the US removed the export-license requirement on June 30, Anthropic restored Fable 5 globally on July 1, 2026 (Mythos 5 first for US organizations), gave paid plans up to 50% of weekly limits on Fable through July 7, and added a classifier blocking the reported jailbreak in over 99% of cases.

events.summary: Anthropic announced general availability on the Claude Platform of the computer-use toolset (multi-action turns, HIPAA-eligible under a BAA), a new browser-use tool, the Skills API and the Files API (1 TB per organization, automatic expiry, 5x rate limits), with one customer reporting about 30% lower cost per task.

events.headline: Claude in Chrome reaches general availability on all paid plans

events.headline: Anthropic unveils Enterprise Frontier Safeguards: zero retention with customer-held data
events.summary: Anthropic introduced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, moving Fable 5/5.1 misuse-monitoring data into customer-controlled cloud storage so customers get zero retention at no Anthropic charge (cloud storage and egress billed by the provider), rolling out from fall 2026 with eligible customers on zero retention meanwhile.
